notes: Italy + Spain + Singapore reviewed 2026-09-28. TIM 12+1 month lifecycle and a current EUR5 recharge option are official. Movistar remains 6 months plus a 54-day receive/recovery tail and official EUR5 minimum recharge. Singtel remains negative knowledge: passport registration is limited to 30 days; passport self-registration grants data-only features, and durable retention requires Singpass or a Singapore-issued ID/work pass.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Current TIM support: a TIM Card is valid for 12 months from activation, the latest recharge, or another qualifying customer-requested commercial event; month 13 is receive-calls-and-SMS only before deactivation. Free number reactivation is available for up to 11 months after expiry.

keep.action: A current EUR5 TIM recharge option exists; any recharge resets the 12-month validity clock. Month 13 is receive-only, then deactivation; free number reactivation is available for up to 11 months after expiry.

routes.chinaActivation: Italian prepaid requires ID (passport) registration; typically in-store Italy. Online eSIM + passport flow 验证中.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving abroad works (EU roaming zone free; China receive 验证中).
routes.tariffSummary: 12-month validity per recharge; current EUR5 recharge option; month 13 receive-only.
guideSteps: Acquire TIM prepaid in Italy and complete required identity registration.
Use a current EUR5 recharge option before the 12-month validity boundary.
If the number expires, request free reactivation within the documented 11-month recovery window.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Current Movistar moderated-community guidance: prepaid validity is 6 months and renews with each recharge. If no recharge occurs, a 54-day tail follows: calls and SMS can be received for 40 days, then only SMS for the final 14 days; no recharge by day 54 means deactivation and number loss.

keep.action: Recharge at least EUR5 before the 6-month boundary to renew validity. If missed, the 54-day tail is a recovery window rather than the normal keep-alive schedule.

routes.chinaActivation: Spanish prepaid passport registration; in-store standard; abroad activation unverified.
routes.payment: Official bank-card recharge accepts national or foreign Visa/Mastercard; channel-specific limits can differ.
routes.roamingSms: EU roaming standard; China receive 验证中.
routes.tariffSummary: 6-month validity per recharge; EUR5 minimum official recharge; 54-day recovery/receive tail.
guideSteps: Acquire Movistar Prepago in Spain and complete required identity registration.
Recharge at least EUR5 before 6 months elapse from the prior recharge.
If the deadline is missed, recharge during the first 40 days of the 54-day tail to recover expired balance and avoid final number loss.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Current Singtel registration guidance reconfirms a 30-day validity cap for passport registration. Passport self-registration grants data-only features; retaining the SIM beyond 30 days requires re-registration with Singpass or an original Singapore-issued ID/work pass through supported Singtel channels.

keep.action: BLOCKED for passport-only overseas retention: passport registration is capped at 30 days, and retention beyond that requires Singpass or a Singapore-issued ID/work pass. Passport self-registration only grants data-only features.

routes.chinaActivation: Passport self-registration can activate data-only features, but it does not provide a durable voice/SMS route and remains subject to the 30-day passport cap.
routes.kyc: IMDA-mandated registration; passport registration = 30-day cap and data-only self-registration. Durable retention requires Singpass or an original Singapore-issued ID/work pass.
routes.roamingSms: Not a viable passport-self-registration OTP/SMS route: current Singtel guidance limits passport self-registration to data-only features.
routes.holdReason: Passport-only users face a 30-day registration cap; current self-registration with passport is data-only, and durable retention requires Singpass or a Singapore-issued ID/work pass. Keep as negative knowledge, not a recommendation.
routes.tariffSummary: Passport registration: 30-day cap; passport self-registration is data-only; durable retention requires Singapore credentials.
guideSteps: Do not recommend this route for passport-only overseas number retention; use it as an avoid-route warning.
